{{hatnote|Historical official Players Committee website domain. For the modern official site see [https://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org].}}

'''swccgpc.com''' was the official website domain of the Star Wars CCG [[Players Committee]] (PC) until June 2009, when the PC moved to starwarsccg.org.

== Role ==

By '''6 November 2002''' the domain hosted ''The SWCCG Player's Committee'', the official website for the Star Wars Customizable Card Game.<ref name="swccgpc2002s">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021106101746/http://www.swccgpc.com/ The SWCCG Player's Committee], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 6 November 2002)</ref>

In '''mid-2006''' the domain still hosted the official Advocates roster.<ref name="advocates2006s">[https://web.archive.org/web/20060617221233/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Content&pa=showpage&pid=3 Advocates], swccgpc.com (published 2006-05-01; Wayback 17 June 2006)</ref> By '''31 August 2008''' the site's PHP-Nuke '''Encyclopedia''' module was a player-resource hub (rules, virtual cards, tournaments, volunteers, tools, store, premium membership)&mdash;see [[swccgpc.com Encyclopedia]].<ref name="enc2008s">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080831140913/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Encyclopedia Encyclopedia], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 31 August 2008)</ref>

On '''10 June 2009''', PC news announced completion of a move to a new server and forwarding to the new domain '''StarWarsCCG.org''' (starwarsccg.org).<ref name="domain2009s">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090706102740/http://www.starwarsccg.org/news/news.php?id=69 New Domain and Server], starwarsccg.org (posted 10 June 2009; Wayback 6 July 2009)</ref>
